issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) refer to a Farm method named printFarmSong(), but both the template and the solution implement and reference singFarmSong() instead. This naming mismatch between the specification and the provided code can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement and UML to refer to singFarmSong(), or add a printFarmSong() method in Farm (in the template and solution) that delegates to singFarmSong(). Also update any example usages (e.g., in Main) to use the chosen name.
